description: This PHP class defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) called LeaveOverlapParams within the OrangeHRM project, specifically for the Leave plugin. It extends LeaveParameterObject and implements methods with logic to handle leave overlap parameters, including methods that throw exceptions when inappropriate operations are attempted.

classes.name: LeaveOverlapParams
classes.description: A DTO class for handling leave overlap parameters, extending LeaveParameterObject with specific behavior and exceptions for invalid operations.

methods.name: getLeaveType
methods.description: Returns the leave type as an integer; here, it throws a LogicException indicating the operation is not allowed.

methods.name: setLeaveType
methods.description: Sets the leave type; intentionally left blank, indicating it might be a read-only or placeholder implementation.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Returns a comment string or null; here, it throws a LogicException indicating the operation is not allowed.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Sets a comment; intentionally left blank, potentially a placeholder.

methods.name: getLogicException
methods.description: Creates and returns a new LogicException with a message indicating the operation is not permitted for this class.
